decisions.statement: A row Monarch no longer lists is retired on the fetched window rather than on a missing id.
A reconciliation retiring more than a twentieth of the rows weighed is refused.
Nothing is retired where the ceiling is passed rather than the first rows being taken.
A window is cut by the day a transaction fell on rather than by the month its page has.
A pending row Monarch no longer lists is cleared.
The scope reconciled against is named in the refusal.

definition: our copy weighed against what Monarch listed, and what Monarch no longer lists retired
